subject: Television & Streaming
title: Gene Roddenberry's Impossible Vision
description: A quick win: understand Gene Roddenberry's Impossible Vision.

hook.text: Gene Roddenberry pitched Star Trek as 'Wagon Train to the stars.' What he really wanted was a show about equality.

buildup.text: He cast Nichelle Nichols as Uhura—a Black woman in a command role in 1966. NBC executives told him to remove her.

discovery.text: Gene Roddenberry's Impossible Vision reveals the mechanism or argument that changes the picture.

twist.text: The show was canceled after three seasons.

climax.text: Roddenberry proved that TV could imagine a better future—and that imagining it was the first step toward building it.

punchline.text: He created a future where humanity had grown up.

quiz.question: Who personally convinced Nichelle Nichols to remain on Star Trek?
